title: A prescribed inseparable generic extension on a finite radicial cover
statement: Let S be reduced, η a generic point of a component, and K/κ(η) finite purely inseparable. There is an affine open U containing η, a finitely presented finite surjective universally injective V→U, and a cartesian square whose base change to Spec κ(η) is Spec K→Spec κ(η). The map Spec κ(η)→U composes to the canonical residue-field map to S. proof.text: The local stalk at η is a field because S is reduced and η is component generic, hence the residue map is an isomorphism. The finite field extension induces a finitely presented finite surjection of spectra. For universal injectivity, two field-valued points agreeing on κ(η) agree on K by pure inseparability. Transport along the stalk-residue isomorphism and apply the local radicial-neighbourhood model theorem, then transport its square back to the residue field.

theorem exists_purely_inseparable_generic_cover
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsReduced S] (η : S)
    (hη : ∃ C ∈ irreducibleComponents S, IsGenericPoint η C)
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra (S.residueField η) K]
    [Module.Finite (S.residueField η) K] [IsPurelyInseparable (S.residueField η) K] :
    ∃ (U : S.Opens) (_ : η ∈ U) (_ : IsAffineOpen U)
      (V : Scheme.{u}) (p : V ⟶ U.toScheme)
      (a : Spec (S.residueField η) ⟶ U.toScheme),
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation p ∧ IsFinite p ∧ Surjective p ∧
      UniversallyInjective p ∧ a ≫ U.ι = S.fromSpecResidueField η ∧
      ∃ h : Spec (.of K) ⟶ V,
        IsPullback h (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField η) K))) p a
